profile.headline: Software Developer @FloridaLottery // Create a gratifying experience for lottery players
profile.summary:
I am a software developer with 5+ years of experience, having previously worked with a client in the banking sector and currently working with the Florida Lottery for over 3 years. I hold a Master of Science in Computer Science from the University of Windsor, Canada.

Core Stack:

Languages: Java, Python, Bash, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, C/C++ (Basic)
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Struts, JAX-RS, React.js, Vue.js, Angular, Django
Database: Relational, NoSQL, Oracle PL/SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, H2, Redis, MongoDB
Message Queue: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS
Testing: Selenium, JUnit, Mockito, Allure Reports, JMeter, Locust
Workflow Automation: GIT Version Control, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Data Factory and E-T-L Pipelines
Application Servers: Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, Apache Tomcat, Jetty
Cloud Services: AWS (EC2, Lambda, EKS, S3, VPC, IAM), Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Microsoft Azure
Tools: Postman, Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, Terraform, Dynatrace, Maven, Gradle, Bazel, Jupyter notebook, Codex, Claude Code, Copilot
Operating Systems: Unix, Mac, Windows
Practices: TDD, SDLC, Agile Scrum, Agile Kanban, Software Engineering, Microservices, Monolith

I am drawn to problems at the intersection of cloud-native backend architecture, DevOps, and distributed systems — and I am increasingly exploring how AI fits into that stack.
 
I am always interested in connecting with engineers, technical leaders, and organizations working on challenging problems and building impactful software.

Thank you for giving it your time. Have a blissful day!

projects.title: Job Application
projects.description: This is a job search application built using Spring Boot micro-services. The application act as a back-end to job search web application. The app provides the functionality of finding jobs, posting jobs and provide reviews to the companies. Many different Spring Boot concepts, a wide range of tool and technologies are leveraged to develop this application. The application is deployed using docker containers for the purpose of scaling, platform independency, load-balancing and optimal performance.

projects.title: A slack like communication platform for software enterprises
projects.description: The web application designed to serve as a communication platform for the personal and organizational use primarily for the software enterprises. The web application allows to create private as well as public communication channel. It also, allows to send messages and share media. The  web application is developed using React, Redux, Firebase Relational database and deployed over Firebase.
